content: Rilpivirine increases the risk of toxicity of arsenic trioxide by prolonging the QTc interval. Caution should be exercised, and monitoring is recommended. Rilpivirine should be used cautiously when co-administered with drugs known to increase the risk of Torsades de Pointes, as it can exacerbate QTc prolongation. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of artemether/lumefantrine by prolonging the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of asenapine by prolonging the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Asenapine transdermal and rilpivirine both prolong the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are necessary. Aspirin/citric acid/sodium bicarbonate decreases rilpivirine levels by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Therapy modification or close monitoring is required. Co-administration of antacids with rilpivirine can significantly reduce rilpivirine plasma concentrations due to increased gastric pH. Antacids should be administered at least 2 hours before or at least 4 hours after rilpivirine. For the combination product dolutegravir/rilpivirine, antacids should be given at least 4 hours before or at least 6 hours afterward. Atazanavir increases rilpivirine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rilpivirine is not expected to affect the plasma concentrations of co-administered protease inhibitors. Atomoxetine and rilpivirine both prolong the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are necessary. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of azithromycin by prolonging the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Calcium acetate decreases rilpivirine levels by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Therapy modification or close monitoring is required. Calcium carbonate decreases rilpivirine levels by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Therapy modification or close monitoring is required. Calcium chloride decreases rilpivirine levels by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Therapy modification or close monitoring is required. Calcium citrate decreases rilpivirine levels by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Therapy modification or close monitoring is required. Calcium gluconate decreases rilpivirine levels by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Therapy modification or close monitoring is required. Calcium/vitamin D decreases rilpivirine levels by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Therapy modification or close monitoring is required. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of chlorpromazine by prolonging the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Cimetidine decreases rilpivirine levels by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Therapy modification or close monitoring is required. Concurrent use may lead to treatment failure or resistance to rilpivirine or NNRTIs. H2 antagonists should be administered at least 12 hours before or at least 4 hours after rilpivirine. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of ciprofloxacin by prolonging the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of citalopram by prolonging the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Clarithromycin increases rilpivirine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rilpivirine also increases the toxicity of clarithromycin by prolonging the QTc interval. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of clomipramine by prolonging the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Clozapine and rilpivirine both prolong the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are necessary. Conivaptan increases rilpivirine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Crizotinib increases rilpivirine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Dose reduction may be needed for drugs metabolized predominantly by CYP3A. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of cyclobenzaprine by prolonging the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of dasatinib by prolonging the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of degarelix by prolonging the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of desipramine by prolonging the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Deutetrabenazine and rilpivirine both prolong the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are necessary. At the maximum recommended dose, deutetrabenazine does not prolong the QT interval to a clinically relevant extent. Certain conditions, such as bradycardia, hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, co-administration with other QT-prolonging drugs, or congenital QT prolongation, may increase the risk of Torsades de Pointes or sudden death. Didanosine affects rilpivirine metabolism via CYP3A4. Caution and monitoring are advised. Didanosine chewable tablets and oral solution should be administered 2 hours before or several hours after rilpivirine. No dose adjustment is required when rilpivirine is co-administered with didanosine. Didanosine should be taken on an empty stomach, at least 2 hours before or 4 hours after rilpivirine, which should be taken with a meal. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of disopyramide by prolonging the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of dofetilide by prolonging the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of dolasetron by prolonging the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Donepezil and rilpivirine both prolong the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are necessary. Doxepin and rilpivirine both prolong the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are necessary. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of dronedarone by prolonging the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of droperidol by prolonging the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Eliglustat and rilpivirine both prolong the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are necessary. Erythromycin base increases rilpivirine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rilpivirine also increases the toxicity of erythromycin base by prolonging the QTc interval. Erythromycin ethylsuccinate increases rilpivirine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rilpivirine also increases the toxicity of erythromycin ethylsuccinate by prolonging the QTc interval. Erythromycin lactobionate increases rilpivirine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rilpivirine also increases the toxicity of erythromycin lactobionate by prolonging the QTc interval. Erythromycin stearate increases rilpivirine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rilpivirine also increases the toxicity of erythromycin stearate by prolonging the QTc interval. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of escitalopram by prolonging the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Escitalopram also increases the toxicity of rilpivirine by prolonging the QTc interval. Famotidine decreases rilpivirine levels by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Therapy modification or close monitoring is required. Famotidine should be administered at least 12 hours before or at least 4 hours after rilpivirine. Fingolimod and rilpivirine both prolong the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are necessary. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of flecainide by prolonging the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Fluconazole increases rilpivirine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. No rilpivirine dose adjustment is required. Rilpivirine also increases the toxicity of fluconazole by prolonging the QTc interval. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of fluoxetine by prolonging the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Fosamprenavir increases rilpivirine effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rilpivirine does not affect the plasma concentrations of co-administered protease inhibitors. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of foscarnet by prolonging the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rilpivirine and fostemsavir both prolong the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are necessary. QTc prolongation has been reported with higher-than-recommended doses of fostemsavir. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of gemifloxacin by prolonging the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Gepirone and rilpivirine both prolong the QTc interval. Therapy modification or close monitoring is required. Gilteritinib and rilpivirine both prolong the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are necessary. Granisetron and rilpivirine both prolong the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are necessary. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of haloperidol by prolonging the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Hydroxyzine and rilpivirine both prolong the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are necessary. Ibuprofen/famotidine decreases rilpivirine levels by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Caution and monitoring are advised. Famotidine should be administered at least 12 hours before or at least 4 hours after rilpivirine. Ibutilide increases rilpivirine toxicity by prolonging the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rilpivirine also increases the toxicity of ibutilide by prolonging the QTc interval. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of iloperidone by prolonging the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of indapamide by prolonging the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Indinavir increases rilpivirine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Isoniazid increases rilpivirine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of isradipine by prolonging the QTc interval. Caution and monitoring are recommended.
